notes.title: 1.11 Save Fix
notes.notes: Thanks to the input from a user I have resolved an issue dealing with the save feature in which it only saved the data from your last session. It now should worked as I intended. If you run into any more problems be sure to respond to this announcement. Thanks!

notes.title: 1.1 Is Out! Saving Beta!
notes.notes:
The 1.1 update is now out that includes saving. Keep in mind this is in beta so as of now only your chests save. There also may be a few bugs and issues people may run into when saving occurs. Please make sure to contact me at 100Chests@gmail.com or @100ChestsGame on twitter so I can fix bugs if you find them.

-Added saving into the game
-Known issue when switching levels sometimes you can't raise the torch (working on a fix)

Thanks!

notes.title: 100 Chests Is Now Available On Steam!
notes.notes: 100 Chests is now available for purchase on steam! Thanks to everyone on kickstarter who made this possible. If you come across and bugs or issues be sure to email me at 100Chests@gmail.com or @100ChestsGame on twitter. Thanks!
